title: Type narrowing, guards, and discriminated unions interview drills

items.question: In production typescript, how would you explain typeof, in, and instanceof narrowing to a junior engineer debugging a related bug?
items.answer: Start with the mechanism: what the compiler does at typeof, in, and instanceof narrowing. Give a 5-line example, name one pitfall (validation, async ordering, or null), and one tradeoff versus the shortcut. Mention how you would prove the fix with a test or DevTools.
followUps: What breaks if you skip validation at the boundary?
How does this differ in JavaScript?
items.sixtySeconds: typeof, in, and instanceof narrowing: mechanism + example + pitfall + comparison — avoid hand-waving.
